repos.name: pocket-ledger
repos.description: Track who owes whom after a trip.

repos.name: tiny-todo
repos.description: A to-do list that lives in your terminal.

repos.name: weather-card
repos.description: A small weather widget for any website.

repos.name: recipe-scaler
repos.description: Scale a recipe to any number of guests.

bounties.title: Balance shows -0.00 when everyone is settled
bounties.problem: After the last payment the balance reads "-0.00" instead of "0.00". It looks like somebody still owes something, and people keep asking who.
bounties.expected: A balance of zero is shown as "0.00", never with a minus sign.
criteria: A zero balance is shown as `0.00`
Tiny negative rounding errors (above -0.005) count as zero
A test covers both cases
bounties.author: devon-ray

bounties.title: Export the ledger as a CSV file
bounties.problem: There is no way to get the ledger out of the app. Treasurers copy the numbers into a spreadsheet by hand after every trip.
bounties.expected: An `export` command writes the ledger to a CSV file with one row per expense.
criteria: The file has the columns date, description, amount, paid by
Amounts use a dot as the decimal separator
Descriptions with commas or quotes are escaped correctly
bounties.author: ines-park

bounties.title: Expenses added offline disappear after syncing
bounties.problem: Expenses entered without a connection are gone after the next sync. The phone shows them until the app reconnects, then they vanish.
bounties.expected: Expenses added offline are still there after syncing, and the other devices see them.
criteria: Offline expenses survive a sync
An expense is never uploaded twice
A test simulates going offline and back

bounties.title: Completed tasks come back after a restart
bounties.problem: Tick a task as done, close the terminal, open it again: the task is back on the list, unticked.
bounties.expected: A completed task stays completed after a restart.
criteria: The done state is saved to the list file
Existing list files without a done state still load
A test covers saving and loading
bounties.author: sam-oduya

bounties.title: Understand due dates like "tomorrow" and "next friday"
bounties.problem: Due dates must be typed as 2026-10-12. Nobody does that. Everyone types "tomorrow".
bounties.expected: `tiny-todo add "call mum" --due tomorrow` sets the due date to the next day.
criteria: `today`, `tomorrow` and weekday names are understood
`next friday` means the Friday of next week
Unknown words give a clear error instead of being ignored

bounties.title: Tasks with emoji break the list alignment
bounties.problem: A task with an emoji pushes its due date out of its column, so the list looks broken.
bounties.expected: Columns stay aligned whatever characters a task contains.
criteria: Emoji do not shift the columns
Plain text lists look exactly as before
bounties.author: lukas-b

bounties.title: Valid emails with a plus sign are rejected
bounties.problem: `anna+shop@example.com` is a perfectly valid address, but the form says it is invalid. Plenty of people use plus addressing to sort their mail.
bounties.expected: Addresses with a plus sign in the name part are accepted.
criteria: `anna+shop@example.com` is accepted
Addresses without an @ or without a domain are still rejected
A test covers both
bounties.author: tomek-w

bounties.title: Password meter calls "password123" strong
bounties.problem: The strength meter only counts character types, so "password123" scores green. It is one of the first passwords any attacker tries.
bounties.expected: Common passwords are rated weak, whatever characters they contain.
criteria: A list of common passwords is checked, case-insensitively
"password123" and "Qwerty2024" are weak
A long random passphrase is still strong
bounties.author: devon-ray

bounties.title: The show/hide password button cannot be used with a keyboard
bounties.problem: Tabbing through the form skips the button that reveals the password, so keyboard and screen reader users cannot use it.
bounties.expected: The button can be reached with Tab and toggled with Enter or Space.
criteria: The button is a real button element in the tab order
It announces whether the password is shown or hidden
The focus ring is visible

bounties.title: The forecast shows the wrong weekday in other time zones
bounties.problem: Seen from Sydney, the card labels tomorrow's forecast with today's weekday. The dates are computed in UTC instead of the visitor's time zone.
bounties.expected: Each forecast day is labelled with the weekday in the viewer's own time zone.
criteria: Weekdays follow the viewer's time zone
Days around midnight UTC are labelled correctly
A test runs with at least two time zones
bounties.author: ines-park

bounties.title: Temperature shows "undefined°" when the visitor is offline
bounties.problem: Without a connection the card renders "undefined°" instead of saying that nothing could be loaded.
bounties.expected: An offline card shows the last known temperature, or a short message when there is none.
criteria: "undefined" never appears on the card
The last successful reading is shown with its age
A test covers the offline case

bounties.title: Round ingredient amounts to kitchen-friendly fractions
bounties.problem: Scaling a recipe for 5 people gives "0.6667 cup of flour". Nobody owns a 0.6667 cup.
bounties.expected: Amounts are rounded to fractions a measuring cup has: 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 3/4.
criteria: 0.6667 cup is shown as 2/3 cup
Whole numbers and amounts in grams are left alone
A test covers the common fractions
bounties.author: sam-oduya
